guide.body: Chapter order is the order the book narrates events in, and the base of this page; with story-order comparison on, the vertical deviation is the gap to the order they happened — a crossing is an analepsis or prolepsis. Story order needs event analysis (EEP) first; flashback detection additionally needs story-time hints on 60% of events, and those hints are set during knowledge-graph extraction.

narrative.confNoteNone: Confidence is the model's own reading of how strong the chapter-summary evidence is — not the probability that the stage exists. Stages below 0.6 would be shown and marked unconfirmed; this book has none.

unclassified.classifyConfirmBody: Recomputes kernel/satellite for the whole book from the existing event-analysis (EEP) cache. No LLM call, no token cost. If every cache entry is gone the server refuses, so existing classifications cannot be wiped.

unclassified.refineConfirmBody: Sends one LLM request per event to judge kernel vs satellite. This spends tokens, and takes longer the more events there are. The verdicts overwrite these events\u2019 current weights.

All three read chapter summaries, not the source text — with summaries missing, the analysis reports success and produces zero stages, so check the prerequisites below first.
